title: build(core): @objectstack/core emits two separate declarations (.d.ts and .d.cts) of the same classes, so it cannot serve per-format types and attw reports FalseESM
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location, measured once. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-steve` · session `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** `@objectstack/core` is the one published package that still hands an ESM TypeScript consumer the CommonJS declarations (attw `FalseESM`, 2 entries). The obvious fix of serving types per format, which #26198 applied to 38 other packages, breaks consumers. Its `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts` declare the same classes twice with private members (`ObjectKernel`'s `plugins`), so a program that reaches `core` through both resolution modes sees two incompatible `ObjectKernel` types.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:devx` seat (core's build config, `packages/core/tsup.config.*`).

## Measured

- On PR #26198 at `23f2dea480`, with core's types split per condition, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-dev build` fails TS2345 at `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin.ts:523` (a CommonJS build that awaits `import('@objectstack/objectql')`). Without the split it exits 0. Reported in os-dev report 6419735271, out_of_scope_findings[0].
- So core keeps a single `types` entry, and attw on the `npm pack` staging still reports `FalseESM` for core.

## Wanted

Make core's declaration build emit one declaration both formats share (for example a single `.d.ts` that the `.d.cts` re-exports, or the bundler's shared-dts option), then serve types per condition like the other 38 packages. ⛔ No export-map subpath added or removed.

## Acceptance

- attw on core's packed tarball: 0 `FalseESM`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-dev build` exits 0 with core's per-condition types in place.

Related: #26095, PR #26198.
